completion_2026_10_26.schema_decision: The six legacy fields (seal_no, reference, al_sindi_1999_no, gulf_type, site, bbm_no) are unchanged in name, order and convention ('' = not applicable/unknown, never the paper's 'N/A'). Five measurement fields from the spreadsheet are added after bbm_no: th (XLS 'TH. ', total height), dh (XLS 'DH', disc height), dia (XLS 'Dia', diameter), boss_dia (XLS 'boss dia', boss diameter), grooves (XLS 'Groves' [sic]). Measurement values are JSON numbers, or null where the source cell is 'N/A', blank, or a non-numeric note. The printed table's derived columns (Boss Height = TH-DH, Collar Width x2 = Dia-boss dia) are NOT carried — they are arithmetic on the carried fields. Each row gains a 'provenance' object: sources consulted, reference form, the fields whose XLS cell was 'N/A' or blank, and per-row adjudication notes where one applies.
